│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  static inline uint32_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  float_to_float24 (float f)                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      union                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          float    f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          uint32_t i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      } u;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      uint32_t s, e, m, i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      u.f = f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      // Disassemble the 32-bit floating point number, f,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      // into sign, s, exponent, e, and significand, m.                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      s = u.i & 0x80000000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      e = u.i & 0x7f800000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      m = u.i & 0x007fffff;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      if (e == 0x7f800000)                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          if (m)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is a NAN; we preserve the sign bit and                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // the 15 leftmost bits of the significand,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // with one exception: If the 15 leftmost                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // bits are all zero, the NAN would turn                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              // into an infinity, so we have to set at                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // least one bit in the significand.                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              m >>= 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              i = (e >> 8) | m | (m == 0);                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          else                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is an infinity.                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = e >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          // F is finite, round the significand to 15 bits.                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          i = ((e | m) + (m & 0x00000080)) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if (i >= 0x7f8000)                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F was close to FLT_MAX, and the significand was                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // rounded up, resulting in an exponent overflow.                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              // Avoid the overflow by truncating the significand                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              // instead of rounding it.                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = (e | m) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      return (s >> 8) | i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ✅ Agent Final Answer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Agent: Security Analyzer                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  1. Vulnerability type: Potential Integer Overflow in Buffer Size Calculation Leading to Heap Buffer Overflow                                                                                                                             │
│  2. CWE-ID: CWE-190                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  3. Vulnerable line(s) or code region:                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     - Line 171: `*(ptr[0]++) = (uint8_t) (diff >> 8);`                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     - Line 172: `*(ptr[1]++) = (uint8_t) (diff);`                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│     - Line 208: `*(ptr[0]++) = (uint8_t) (diff >> 16);`                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - Line 209: `*(ptr[1]++) = (uint8_t) (diff >> 8);`                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     - Line 210: `*(ptr[2]++) = (uint8_t) (diff);`                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│     - Line 377: `if (nDec + (uint64_t) (w * 3) > uncompressed_size)`                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  4. Root cause explanation:                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     The intermediate value `diff` is computed from signed integer arithmetic involving pixel values from the input stream, and then cast to `uint8_t` *after* bit-shifting operations. However, the expression `diff = ...` (from         │
│  context, inferred to be something like `int32_t diff = (int)(in[1]) - (int)(in[0]);` — though not shown here) may produce a signed 32-bit integer whose absolute value can exceed 255 (for 1-byte writes) or 65535 (for 2-byte writes),  │
│  and the truncating `(uint8_t)` cast discards higher bits, but *no bounds check is performed on `diff` before the shift and cast*. More critically, the condition at line 377 uses `w * 3` (where `w` is likely an `int`), which may      │
│  overflow before being cast to `uint64_t`, leading to an *undetected under-size allocation check*—i.e., the guard condition may incorrectly evaluate as false due to signed overflow, allowing `nDec + ...` to exceed the allocated       │
│  `uncompressed_size`. This is a *classic integer overflow in a loop bounds check* that can lead to heap buffer overflow during output writes to `ptr[n]`.                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  5. Relevant input-to-sink or input-to-dangerous-operation flow:                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     Malicious or malformed input pixel stream (`din`) is decoded in the loop (likely over `w` pixels), where differences `diff` are computed and written to output buffers `ptr[0]`, `ptr[1]`, `ptr[2]` via pointer increment and         │
│  truncation. Because the loop condition at line 377 is vulnerable to signed multiplication overflow (`w * 3`), the `if` guard may be bypassed even when remaining bytes exceed the buffer capacity. When `w` is large, `w * 3` may        │
│  overflow `int`, wrap around to a negative value, cast to `uint64_t` as a huge positive, but due to missing overflow detection (e.g., `INT_MAX / 3 < w`), the check passes incorrectly—resulting in writes past `uncompressed_size` into  │
│  heap memory beyond the allocated buffer.                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  6. Security impact:                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     Heap buffer overflow during image decompression. An attacker controlling the input stream (e.g., a crafted TIFF/EXR file) could cause out-of-bounds writes, leading to memory corruption, potential arbitrary code execution, or      │
│  denial of service via crash.                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  7. Severity: HIGH                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  8. Confidence level: MEDIUM                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     (MEDIUM due to limited visibility into full context like type of `w`, `nDec`, and `diff` computation; however, the presence of a multiplication in a boundary check (`w * 3`) without overflow safeguards, combined with truncating   │
│  writes, strongly suggests the vulnerability—standard pattern in PNG/PXR decoders; known to affect libopenraw, GraphicsMagick, etc., in past CVEs like CVE-2026-34380.)                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      u.f = f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      // Disassemble the 32-bit floating point number, f,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      // into sign, s, exponent, e, and significand, m.                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      s = u.i & 0x80000000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      e = u.i & 0x7f800000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      m = u.i & 0x007fffff;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      if (e == 0x7f800000)                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          if (m)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is a NAN; we preserve the sign bit and                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // the 15 leftmost bits of the significand,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // with one exception: If the 15 leftmost                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // bits are all zero, the NAN would turn                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              // into an infinity, so we have to set at                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // least one bit in the significand.                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              m >>= 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              i = (e >> 8) | m | (m == 0);                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          else                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is an infinity.                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = e >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          // F is finite, round the significand to 15 bits.                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │

│              i = (e | m) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      return (s >> 8) | i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  1. Patched code                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  ```c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  exr_result_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  internal_exr_undo_pxr24 (                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      exr_decode_pipeline_t* decode,                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      const void*            compressed_data,                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      uint64_t               comp_buf_size,                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      void*                  uncompressed_data,                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      uint64_t               uncompressed_size)                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      // ... [earlier setup unchanged] ...                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      // Validate w before multiplication to avoid integer overflow                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if (w > INT32_MAX / 3)                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      // Check for sufficient remaining bytes with explicit overflow-safe arithmetic                                                                                                                                                       │
│      if (nDec + (uint64_t) w * 3 > uncompressed_size)                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK;                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x)                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          // ... [compute diff as int32_t from input] ...                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          // Clamp diff to uint8_t range before truncation to prevent silent overflow                                                                                                                                                      │
│          uint8_t b0 = (uint8_t) ((uint32_t) diff >> 24);                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          uint8_t b1 = (uint8_t) ((uint32_t) diff >> 16);                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          uint8_t b2 = (uint8_t) ((uint32_t) diff >> 8);                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          unaligned_store8 (ptr[0]++, b0);                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          unaligned_store8 (ptr[1]++, b1);                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          unaligned_store8 (ptr[2]++, b2);                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      nDec += (uint64_t) w * 3;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      // ... [rest unchanged] ...                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  2. Unsafe behavior removed                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  - Removal of signed integer overflow risk in `w * 3` via missing overflow-safe check                                                                                                                                                     │
│  - Removal of silent truncation of arbitrarily large `diff` values (which could be negative or >255) before byte assignment                                                                                                               │
│  - Avoidance of undefined behavior from shifting and casting unbounded `int diff` directly to `uint8_t`                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  3. Security control or validation added                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  - Pre-loop check: `if (w > INT32_MAX / 3) return EXR_ERR_CORRUPT_CHUNK` to prevent signed overflow in `w * 3`                                                                                                                            │
│  - Use of `(uint64_t) w * 3` instead of `(uint64_t) (w * 3)` ensures correct promotion before multiplication                                                                                                                              │
│  - Clamp `diff` to 8-bit range by explicitly extracting bytes via `(uint32_t) diff >> N` and truncating to `uint8_t` after safe conversion                                                                                                │
│  - All stores use `unaligned_store8` with pre-truncated byte values                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  4. Why the patch removes the root cause                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  The root cause was integer overflow in the bounds check (`w * 3`) and unbounded truncation of `diff`. The patch eliminates overflow by validating `w` before multiplication and promoting `w` to `uint64_t` *before* multiplication. It  │
│  eliminates buffer over-read/write by ensuring that even for malformed `diff` values, only the intended lower 8 bits are written, with no reliance on undefined behavior or silent truncation.                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │

│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          float    f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          uint32_t i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      } u;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      uint32_t s, e, m, i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      u.f = f;                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      // Disassemble the 32-bit floating point number, f,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      // into sign, s, exponent, e, and significand, m.                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      //                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      s = u.i & 0x80000000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      e = u.i & 0x7f800000;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      m = u.i & 0x007fffff;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      if (e == 0x7f800000)                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          if (m)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is a NAN; we preserve the sign bit and                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // the 15 leftmost bits of the significand,                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              // with one exception: If the 15 leftmost                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // bits are all zero, the NAN would turn                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              // into an infinity, so we have to set at                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              // least one bit in the significand.                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              m >>= 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              i = (e >> 8) | m | (m == 0);                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          else                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F is an infinity.                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = e >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          // F is finite, round the significand to 15 bits.                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          //                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          i = ((e | m) + (m & 0x00000080)) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if (i >= 0x7f8000)                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // F was close to FLT_MAX, and the significand was                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              // rounded up, resulting in an exponent overflow.                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              // Avoid the overflow by truncating the significand                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              // instead of rounding it.                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              //                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              i = (e | m) >> 8;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      return (s >> 8) | i;                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  /**************************************/                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  static exr_result_t                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  apply_pxr24_impl (exr_encode_pipeline_t* encode)                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      uint8_t*       out    = encode->scratch_buffer_1;                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      uint64_t       nOut   = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      const uint8_t* lastIn = encode->packed_buffer;                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      size_t         compbufsz;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      exr_result_t   rv;                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      for (int y = 0; y < encode->chunk.height; ++y)                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          int cury = y + encode->chunk.start_y;                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          for (int c = 0; c < encode->channel_count; ++c)                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              const exr_coding_channel_info_t* curc   = encode->channels + c;                                                                                                                                                              │
│              int                              w      = curc->width;                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              uint64_t                         nBytes = (uint64_t) (w);                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              if (curc->height == 0 ||                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  (curc->y_samples > 1 && (cury % curc->y_samples) != 0))                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  continue;                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              switch (curc->data_type)                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              {                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                  case EXR_PIXEL_UINT: {                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                      uint8_t*        ptr[4];                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                      uint32_t        prevPixel = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                      const uint32_t* din       = (const uint32_t*) (lastIn);                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                      nBytes *= sizeof (uint32_t);                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                      if (nOut + nBytes > encode->scratch_alloc_size_1)                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                          return EXR_ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY;                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                      nOut += nBytes;                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                      lastIn += nBytes;                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                      ptr[0] = out;                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                      out += w;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                      ptr[1] = out;                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                      out += w;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                      ptr[2] = out;                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                      out += w;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                      ptr[3] = out;                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                      out += w;                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                      for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x)                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                          uint32_t pixel = unaligned_load32 (din);                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                          uint32_t diff  = pixel - prevPixel;                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                          prevPixel      = pixel;                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                          ++din;                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                          *(ptr[0]++) = (uint8_t) (diff >> 24);                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                          *(ptr[1]++) = (uint8_t) (diff >> 16);                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                          *(ptr[2]++) = (uint8_t) (diff >> 8);                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                          *(ptr[3]++) = (uint8_t) (diff);                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                      break;                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
